ledger.claim: The rider's same-trip burden under POL-RD-08(a) is met on the face of the bundle: EV-TRIP-00108, EV-GPS-00108 and EV-FARE-00108 all carry trip_id TRP-00108, and the trace runs from the 07:19:20 start to the 07:53:20 end recorded on the trip record, so the artifacts plainly describe one and the same trip.

On this trip's own measurements the deviation is established. The governing figure under POL-RD-01 is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 26.17 km, and the platform's own pre-pass records the resulting excess as 5.17 km, or 24.6% of the 21.0 km booked optimal, which clears both POL-RD-01 thresholds (greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms and greater than 20% of optimal). The rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 26.2 km is a convenience copy of the same measurement and must not be substituted for the trace figure.

Once that excess is shown, POL-RD-08 shifts the burden to the driver to point to a specific artifact and a specific clause, and no extra corroboration is demanded of this rider: the rider-profile condition that would require corroboration beyond the gps_trace bites only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more, and on EV-RPROF-00108 that field is 1, so the rider is exactly the low-frequency claimant the proviso does not touch.

The rider's two chat messages cannot be turned into a rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04. That clause requires the requested waypoint to be taken from chat_message.waypoint_hint, and every message on EV-CHAT-00108 carries waypoint_hint null with no road named, so the corroboration test is undecidable on the record, the clause is unavailable, and the case must be decided on the remaining clauses.

There is no road-closure answer to this claim either. The only traffic-advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-00108-01, is a MISSING artifact that keeps its identifier, carries no payload and holds weight 0.0 under a MISSING_ARTIFACT issue; no advisory therefore names any road, expressway segment or junction the optimal route traverses, and POL-RD-03 can exonerate nothing. The rider cites the absence itself.

The driver's answer is POL-RD-05, but that clause re-bases the optimal; it does not wipe the slate for his own driving. Even on the amended re-quote the platform stored, 24.60 km, the driver's own trace of 26.17 km exceeds the amended optimal by 1.57 km, and the trace records two loops of the T3 departure kerb well inside 380 m of the amended pin - the very circling the rider complains of and the driver concedes ('I went round the loop twice'). The POL-RD-05 circling exclusion does not shelter that distance: it applies only where the rider was not at the amended point, and on the rider's account she was waiting at T3.

The money then follows arithmetically, not discretionarily, under POL-RD-02 on this METERED fare, and EV-FARE-00108 already carries the platform's own computation against the booked optimal: charged_total 33.77, recomputed_fare 27.63, and a refund of 6.15. That is above the 0.50 de-minimis floor and below the 90% full-refund share, so the rider's remedy is the PARTIAL_REFUND the clause provides, stated on the ruling's separate lines of charged_total, recomputed_fare and refund.

If the Tribunal cannot reconcile, within the record alone, the pre-pass reading of the optimal at 21.0 km with the amended re-quote of 24.60 km that POL-RD-05 directs it to use, then the case is not safely resolvable at the POL-RD-10 confidence floor of 0.70 and the correct outcome is ESCALATE, under which the disputed sum is held rather than collected - not NO_ACTION, which on a rider-filed dispute leaves the charge standing against her.

Both trip endpoints were amended after booking, so POL-RD-05 governs the threshold test and not the booked route: pickup_amended_at is 2026-07-20T07:12:30 and dropoff_amended_at is 2026-07-20T07:41:52, and the trip_record carries the platform's own post-amendment re-quote of amended_optimal_distance_km 24.60 with amended_optimal_duration_min 31.0. The record is therefore complete for POL-RD-05 and no substitute figure need be derived.

Re-run POL-RD-01 against the amended endpoints, as POL-RD-05 requires. The governing actual distance is gps_trace.trace_distance_km 26.17, and the governing optimal is the amended 24.60 km, an excess of 1.57 km — only about 6.4% of optimal, far below the 20% limb. POL-RD-01 makes both tests cumulative, so although 1.57 km clears the 0.8 km absolute limb the percentage limb fails, no deviation is established, and POL-RD-05 states the outcome in terms: NO_ACTION.

The 'established' deviation recorded in the GPS artifact's derived block was computed against the BOOKED optimal of 21.0 km, giving excess_km 5.17 and excess_pct 24.6. That is the pre-adjustment measurement only. POL-RD-01 requires establishment and materiality to be assessed on the excess REMAINING after any adjustment under POL-RD-05, and POL-RD-05 displaces the booked optimal once an endpoint has been amended, so the derived 'established' status is superseded and cannot be carried into the ruling as the operative figure.

The 'five minutes driving around the airport' the rider complains of is the T3 kerb loop, and the platform's own note records the vehicle going two loops of the T3 departure kerb well inside 380 m of the amended pin. POL-RD-05 excludes exactly this: where the rider was not at the amended point and the trace shows the vehicle circling within 400 m of it for more than 4 minutes, the circling distance is excluded from excess.

Both amendments were the rider's own instructions, recorded in the chat log and acknowledged by the driver: MSG-00108-001 moves the pickup to Punggol MRT PHV pickup bay, and MSG-00108-003 changes the drop to T3. Distance attributable to rider-amended endpoints is not excess the driver must answer for under POL-RD-05.

There is no billing-integrity defect for the rider to recover independently under POL-RD-09(4): the airport_surcharge line is 0.00 and correctly so, because a trip that ENDS at Changi rather than originating there carries no surcharge, and erp_gantries is empty with tolls_erp 0.00, so no charge line is unmatched to the trace and no standalone correction arises.

No repeat deviation pattern exists, so the rider cannot reach the FULL_REFUND uplift or the conduct referral: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 402, well short of either POL-RD-06 trigger (3 or more flags, or a 0.05 ratio).

The trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07: 206 fixes at a 10 s sampling interval, coverage_pct 100, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, so none of limbs (a) to (c) fires, no independent corroboration is required, and the POL-RD-10(3) escalation route is not engaged.

The traffic-advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00108-01 is absent — weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — and the driver does not rely on it as a ground. No POL-RD-03 exoneration is invoked, because no deviation survives the POL-RD-05 recomputation, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged by the gap and the absence of an advisory does not force escalation.

The filing party is the rider, fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00. NO_ACTION leaves that present state exactly as it stands, so on this rider-filed dispute the $33.77 charge remains with the driver; no refund is due and none should be ordered.

ruling.explanation:
This decision is addressed to both parties. The $33.77 charge stands and no refund is due, because the measurements the policy directs leave no route deviation established.

What the record shows. EV-TRIP-00108 records that the pickup was changed to Punggol MRT at 07:12:30 and the drop-off was changed from Changi T1 to Changi T3 at 07:41:52, and it carries the platform's own post-amendment re-quote between those endpoints: amended_optimal_distance_km 24.60 km and amended_optimal_duration_min 31.0. The rider's own messages (MSG-00108-001 moving the pin, MSG-00108-003 changing the terminal, both acknowledged by the driver) are on EV-CHAT-00108. POL-RD-05 therefore applies in terms.

The threshold test. POL-RD-05 requires POL-RD-01 to be re-run against the amended route. The governing actual distance is gps_trace.trace_distance_km 26.17 km (EV-GPS-00108), not the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 26.2 km. Against the amended optimal of 24.60 km the excess is 1.57 km, or 6.4% of optimal. The 0.8 km absolute limb is passed, but the 20% limb is not, and POL-RD-01 requires both tests to pass. No deviation is established, and POL-RD-05 states the consequence in terms: where no deviation survives the recomputation the outcome is NO_ACTION. This holds whether or not the two T3 kerb loops are excluded as circling, so the parties' disagreement about why the driver circled does not change the result.

The $6.15 figure. The pre-pass recorded a provisional excess of 5.17 km / 24.6% and a refund of 6.15 (charged_total 33.77 less recomputed_fare 27.63). That computation runs against the booked optimal of 21.0 km. POL-RD-05 displaces the booked optimum once an endpoint has been amended, so those figures are the pre-adjustment measurement only and cannot be carried into the ruling. POL-RD-02, which produces the refund arithmetic, operates only where a deviation is established under POL-RD-01; none is.

Other points, for completeness. The trace is unimpaired for POL-RD-07 purposes (206 fixes, 10-second sampling, 100% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0), so no independent corroboration is required and the POL-RD-10(3) escalation route is not engaged. No road-closure exoneration is invoked and none is available: the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00108-01, is a MISSING artifact at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. POL-RD-04 cannot be run because every chat message carries a null waypoint_hint, but POL-RD-04 itself directs that the case then be decided on the remaining clauses, which has been done. There is no billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4): the airport surcharge line is 0.00 and correctly so, because a trip that ends at Changi rather than originating there carries no surcharge, and there are no ERP gantries. No driver compensation arises, because the billed distance (26.2 km) is not less than the trace distance (26.17 km). No repeat-deviation pattern is made out (deviation_flags_90d 0 against 402 completed trips), so no POL-RD-06 conduct referral and no FULL_REFUND uplift arise.

On escalation. The rider asks for ESCALATE if the 21.0 km booked figure and the 24.60 km amended figure cannot be reconciled. There is nothing to reconcile: both amendment timestamps and the amended re-quote are present, the record is complete for POL-RD-05, and POL-RD-05 resolves which figure governs. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires, and the confidence in this ruling (0.88, capped at 1.0 by the weight-1.0 artifacts EV-TRIP-00108 and EV-GPS-00108 that carry the deciding fact) is above the 0.70 floor.

The claim is therefore not supported by the evidence the policy directs the Tribunal to use: payment_status stays CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd stays 0.00. No question is left open for a human reviewer, so the referrals list is empty.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
